{{Quote|I used to be a nurse, you know. That chair is a good device.|The medical supply merchant, to Zeerid Korr|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''merchant''' tended a [[Unidentified warehouse (Vulta)|warehouse]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]] that contained medical supplies. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]], the man, who was a former [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]], [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]] and a course on how to run it. Korr&mdash;who gave the hoverchair to his seven-year-old crippled daughter, [[Arra Yooms]]&mdash;paid the seller 87,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] with a [[bearer card]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|If that's all then, sir. I'll just need you to fill out a few forms. The bearer card is untraceable, as you know.|The merchant, to Zeerid Korr|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] tended a [[Unidentified warehouse (Vulta)|warehouse]] filled with medical supplies located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]].<ref name="Deceived" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with Zeerid Korr's trip to Vulta, per ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] went to the warehouse to buy a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]] for his crippled seven-year-old daughter, [[Arra Yooms]]. The medical supply merchant, who was a former [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]], sold him a used hoverchair fitted for the girl and a crash course on how to use it properly for 87,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], which Korr paid using a [[bearer card]]. The man did not want to accept the bearer card without Korr filling out some forms. Korr, however, left for a local [[Karson's Park|park]] in a hurry and told the man that he would be back the next day to take care of the paperwork.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't see bearer cards all that often.''"<br />"''Credits are credits.|The merchant and Zeerid Korr|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
The man, whose physical appearance in Korr's mind resembled a [[Scarecrow/Legends|scarecrow]], was careful about business deals. He did not want to accept Korr's bearer card for payment without further information, but Korr told him he would come back the next day to fill out the forms. The merchant, who was elderly by 3653 BBY, considered himself knowledgeable about the products he offered and believed that the hoverchair he sold to Korr was a fine product.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The medical supply merchant appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="Deceived" />
